title: Questionable Times
author: AaronH
rules:
Rules

• Sudoku: Fill the grid with digits 1-9 so that no digit repeats in any row, column or 3×3 box.

• ? Black Dots: Digits separated by a question mark black dot have an unspecified integer ratio. This means there is a whole number that can multiply/divide one digit to get the other.

• Maximum Cells: Cells indicated by greater‑than symbols, must contain a digit greater than all of its orthogonally adjacent neighbours.
